h1: Restaurant marketing in South Florida and across the US
answer: Button Up Media is headquartered in Miami. Our crew works in person across South Florida, and we run ads, websites, SEO and AEO for restaurants anywhere in the US.

faqs.q: Which areas do you serve in person?
faqs.a: Our crew works in person with restaurants across South Florida, including South Beach and Miami Beach, Brickell and Downtown Miami, Wynwood, Coral Gables, Doral, Kendall, Pinecrest and Fort Lauderdale.

faqs.q: Do you work with restaurants outside South Florida?
faqs.a: Yes. Google Ads, Meta ads, websites, SEO and AEO are done remotely for restaurants anywhere in the US. For social media, our Miami team plans and manages your content, and the filming is done by our network of experienced videographers and photographers in your area.

faqs.q: Who films our content if we're not in South Florida?
faqs.a: A videographer or photographer from our network in your area. Our Miami team plans what to shoot and handles posting and managing your pages.

faqs.q: Where is Button Up Media based?
faqs.a: Our headquarters is in Miami, Florida. We also have team members local to restaurants in several other states.

cta.body: Book a free 30-minute call and tell us where your restaurant is. Juan will explain how filming would work for you and which services make sense.
